scenarios.name: Transfer a selected command after reversing the source list

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands in ascending order for an empty Part Tools custom panel
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available command list
the user clicks the available command list Name header
the visible source list begins with the separator and descending Zoom commands
the add transfer button remains enabled
the user clicks the add transfer button
"2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
